hero.heading: An energy gel made from honey. Three or four ingredients.
hero.subtitle: Energy gels, isotonic drinks and whey protein made by APIMAR in Poland. The gels are made from multifloral honey and freeze-dried fruit, with no sucralose and no artificial colours.

whyHbp.title: Three or four ingredients, nothing else
whyHbp.subtitle: Made by APIMAR in Poland; Planet Bio is the distributor for Croatia. The ingredients are printed on the back of every pack.
whyHbp.reason1Desc: Honey from Polish apiaries makes up 91–95.5% of the gel, depending on the flavour.
whyHbp.reason2Desc: Freeze-dried lemon, orange or raspberry gives the flavour and colour. No artificial colours.
whyHbp.reason3Desc: Guarana seed extract (1%) contains caffeine. Not recommended for people sensitive to caffeine, pregnant or breastfeeding women, or children.
whyHbp.reason4Desc: The lemon and orange gels contain 0.5% sea salt. The raspberry gel has no salt.

story.title: From Baranów to Našice
story.p1: Honey Bee Power is a brand of the Polish producer P.P.H. APIMAR in Baranów. The gels are made from multifloral honey from Polish apiaries, and the isotonic tub says “Polish product”. Planet Bio, a small business in Našice, is the distributor for Croatia: we keep the products in our warehouse at Krndijska 4 and ship them within 1–3 working days of order confirmation.
story.p2: Orders work by enquiry. You fill the basket and send it by WhatsApp or e-mail, and we agree the shipping cost and payment (cash on delivery or bank transfer) with you directly.
story.photoAlt: Black-and-white photograph of an apiary with wooden hives in an orchard
story.photoCaption: Photograph: an apiary in Łomianki near Warsaw, 1939 (archive).

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: When do I take the gel?
faq.a1: According to the label: 1 serving (40 g) after exercise or physical exertion. The gel is intended for adults after very intensive or long-lasting exercise.
faq.a2: Yes, from guarana seed extract (1%). We are confirming the caffeine content per gel with the producer: <todo>[UPIŠI: caffeine per gel]</todo>. Not recommended for people sensitive to caffeine, pregnant or breastfeeding women, or children.
faq.q3: Is the whey sweetened only with honey?
faq.a3: No. The whey contains dried honey (6%) and stevia, and it contains milk.
faq.a4: Add products to the enquiry and send it by WhatsApp or e-mail. Nothing is paid on the website; we agree shipping and payment (cash on delivery or bank transfer) with you directly.
faq.a5: We ship from Našice, usually within 1–3 working days of confirming the order.
faq.a6: P.P.H. APIMAR in Baranów, Poland. Planet Bio in Našice is the distributor for Croatia.
